matt_pocock_core.precedence: subordinate to PROJECT.xml prime directives P1-P9 and laws L01-L20
matt_pocock_core.purpose: Bind Matt Pocock's composable AI engineering workflows as phase-bound execution plugins inside project-preset's constitutional XML control plane. Strategic architecture, ubiquitous vocabulary and deterministic guardrails stay human-curated; tactical vertical slices execute inside isolated 150k-token Smart Zones.

workflow_chain.phase: Walk the design tree in rounds with numbered options (P4). Delegate factual codebase questions to read-only sub-agents. Update GLOSSARY.md inline as terms settle (THR-44) and record Three-Gate ADRs in docs/adr/ (THR-45). For multi-session initiatives, map decision tickets via /wayfinder first.

phase.session_policy: MUST run in the exact same conversation as GRILL

workflow_chain.phase: Synthesize settled decisions without re-interviewing. Lock module seams, user stories, negative constraints, numeric defaults and testing seams. Audit the generated Spec line-by-line against grilling answers so strict rules are never softened into vague prose.

phase.session_policy: Start clean session reading published Spec

workflow_chain.phase: Decompose the Spec into vertical tracer-bullet tickets scoped to fit cleanly inside a single 150,000-token Smart Zone, with explicit blocked-by edges.

phase.session_policy: One fresh sub-agent + git worktree per ready ticket

workflow_chain.phase: Execute vertical slices via /tdd (red -> green -> refactor) against pre-agreed module seams, using exact GLOSSARY.md names and CODING_STANDARDS.md rules. Small single-session tasks use /implement directly.

Spawn isolated Spec Reviewer, Standards Reviewer and (when touching auth/data/public APIs) Security Reviewer. Run sh .agents/bin/precheck.sh --final, then format PR via /pr with visual summary, runtime evidence and Merge Danger rating (FIN-16).

phase.session_policy: After review or every ~5 automated PRs

workflow_chain.phase: Convert recurring review findings into deterministic compiler flags, lint rules or fast seam tests first (L12); update CODING_STANDARDS.md only when static or runtime enforcement is impossible.

tier.policy: Sampled human review (e.g. 1 in 5 PRs) after CI, code-review and precheck.sh --final pass.
Human architectural diff and runtime evidence inspection before merge.
Mandatory deep human review, security review and explicit sign-off (L08/L09) — covers schema migrations, auth/permissions, billing, external emails and destructive ops.
